story_title: As Venue Staff, I want existing bookings to be re-checked when I change a venue's setup or turnaround time so that bookings that now clash are identified instead of being silently removed or left unnoticed

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a venue's setup or turnaround time (in minutes, 15-minute steps) is changed, when the change is saved, then every pending and confirmed future booking at that venue is re-checked using the new times.

Given two bookings at the venue now occupy overlapping periods once setup and turnaround are included, when the re-check runs, then both bookings are flagged for review and each identifies the booking it clashes with.
Given a booking's setup or turnaround period now overlaps a recorded unavailable period, when the re-check runs, then the booking is flagged for review.
A flagged booking is never cancelled, removed or changed automatically, and keeps its current status.
The assigned Event Coordinator of each flagged booking is notified, with the reason.
Bookings that do not clash under the new times are not flagged.
Bookings for past dates are not re-checked.
New booking requests made after the change are checked for availability and conflicts using the new times.

Logged out.
SPM-80-TC02 continues from where this case ends: go straight to it.

test_cases.expected_result:
Step 3: The venue's page opens, subtitled 'Changes here can affect this venue's bookings. test_cases.preconditions:
SPM-80-TC01 has just been run ('SPM80 Turnaround Room' has a turnaround time of 30 minutes and nothing is flagged).

Venue: SPM80 Turnaround Room (SPM80-TRN)
Turnaround time: 30 → 45 minutes
Morning Seminar now holds the room 10:00–12:45, overlapping the Lunch Forum from 12:30
The EVT- references of SPM80 Morning Seminar and SPM80 Lunch Forum, from the fixture script's output
test_cases.expected_result: Step 2: An amber message titled 'Changes saved — 2 bookings flagged for review, coordinators notified' appears, reading 'These bookings have not been changed. Each one is flagged for its coordinator to decide what to do.' It lists exactly two bookings, in either order: 'SPM80 Morning Seminar: with the venue's new setup or turnaround time, this booking overlaps another booking (clashes with <reference of SPM80 Lunch Forum> SPM80 Lunch Forum)' and 'SPM80 Lunch Forum: with the venue's new setup or turnaround time, this booking overlaps another booking (clashes with <reference of SPM80 Morning Seminar> SPM80 Morning Seminar)'. SPM80 Evening Workshop is not listed (it does not clash), and neither are SPM80 Past Briefing or SPM80 Past Review, although they are also half an hour apart (they are over).

test_cases.title: The coordinator is notified of each clashing booking with the reason, and finds both still Approved and unchanged on Flagged Arrangements, each naming the other
test_cases.preconditions:
SPM-80-TC02 has just been run (SPM80 Morning Seminar and SPM80 Lunch Forum are flagged; the room's turnaround time is 45 minutes).

Coordinator: Daniel Tan
Events: SPM80 Morning Seminar, SPM80 Lunch Forum
Venue: SPM80 Turnaround Room (SPM80-TRN), turnaround now 45 minutes
test_cases.expected_result:
Step 3: At the top are two new notifications titled 'Booking needs review', one for each event. One, under 'SPM80 Morning Seminar · <its reference>', reads 'SPM80 Turnaround Room (SPM80-TRN): the turnaround time changed from 30 to 45 minutes. The approved booking for SPM80 Morning Seminar on 3 Aug 2027, 10:00–12:00 now overlaps the booking for <reference of SPM80 Lunch Forum> SPM80 Lunch Forum on 3 Aug 2027, 12:30–14:00, once setup and turnaround are included. It is flagged for review - nothing has been changed automatically.' The other, under 'SPM80 Lunch Forum · <its reference>', reads the same but for 'The approved booking for SPM80 Lunch Forum on 3 Aug 2027, 12:30–14:00 now overlaps the booking for <reference of SPM80 Morning Seminar> SPM80 Morning Seminar on 3 Aug 2027, 10:00–12:00'. Step 5: 'SPM80 Morning Seminar' is listed at 'SPM80 Turnaround Room (SPM80-TRN)', '3 Aug 2027, 10:00–12:00', with the 'Approved' badge, 'Flagged because: with the venue's new setup or turnaround time, this booking overlaps another booking', 'Availability: Not available' and 'SPM80 Turnaround Room is already booked for <reference of SPM80 Lunch Forum> SPM80 Lunch Forum on 3 Aug 2027, 12:30–12:45.' 'SPM80 Lunch Forum' is listed the same way at '3 Aug 2027, 12:30–14:00', 'Approved', with 'SPM80 Turnaround Room is already booked for <reference of SPM80 Morning Seminar> SPM80 Morning Seminar on 3 Aug 2027, 12:30–12:45.' open_questions: Written on 2026-10-20, after the code and its automated tests (built test-first on branch SPM-80-Re-check-Bookings-When-Setup-or-Turnaround-Time-Changes): src/lib/__tests__/turnaroundRecheck.test.ts, the 'changing the setup or turnaround time (SPM-80)' block of src/app/api/__tests__/venues.test.ts, one test in src/app/__tests__/venue-catalogue-pages.test.tsx, and integration/venue-turnaround-recheck.test.ts. Every label and message quoted here is taken from the code; the cases have not been run by hand yet. Entries marked DECIDED were chosen during the build rather than taken from the story; change them in code and cases together.

RESOLVED 2026-10-20 (Kristen): an approved booking that now clashes only with a pending request is flagged, and its notification names the request, but on Flagged Arrangements it stays 'Availability: Available' with 'Keep booking' offered. The approved booking takes priority, as when Venue Staff approve (SPM-44 AC6): it is the pending request that has to move, and the request's own entry shows 'Not available' and names the approved booking. TC05 checks both.

RESOLVED 2026-10-20 (Kristen): the bookings CUSTOMER_CLARIFICATIONS.md (2026-10-08) expected SPM-80 to flag, left clashing when SPM-93's script rounded two seeded rooms' (CBP-MTG1, CBP-MTG2) times up to a 15-minute step, do not exist. The script's dry run on the shared database reports every venue already on 15-minute steps, and a read-only check on 2026-10-20 found no upcoming pending or approved bookings clashing at either room. The only clashes in the database are other stories' deliberate conflict fixtures (SPM-34, SPM-43, SPM-44). No script is needed.

RESOLVED 2026-10-20 (Kristen): after a save that flags nothing, the venue page now reads 'No bookings were affected, so nobody needed to be notified.' (was 'No approved bookings were affected, …'), for every save, since a setup or turnaround change re-checks pending requests too (TC01, TC04, TC06, TC08, TC09). Ten other cases quote the old wording and are marked Updated with a note: SPM-39-TC05, TC13, TC18, TC22, TC24; SPM-43-TC14; SPM-45-TC01, TC08, TC11; SPM-93-TC07 (docs/test-cases/DECOMMISSIONED.md).

DECIDED 2026-10-20 (AC2, AC3, AC6): only what the change NEWLY breaks is flagged, as with every other venue edit (SPM-39, SPM-45). Two bookings that already overlapped under the old times, or a booking an unavailable period already overlapped, are not flagged again: they were refused or flagged when that arose. So saving the same times twice flags once, and lowering a time flags nothing (TC04).

DECIDED 2026-10-20 (AC4): nothing is un-flagged by the re-check. A booking that no longer clashes after a later change keeps its flag until the coordinator keeps or replaces it on Flagged Arrangements (SPM-68), where it is then offered 'Keep booking' (TC04).

DECIDED 2026-10-20 (AC2): two bookings of the same event never flag each other - one session's turnaround must not flag the same event's next session in the same room - the rule the booking conflict check already uses (SPM-44, SPM-81). No case covers it, since no fixture event has two sessions in one room; the automated tests do.

DECIDED 2026-10-20 (AC7): 'future' means the booking has not ended yet, the rule every venue flag uses. A booking under way when the change is saved is re-checked; one that has finished is not (TC02: SPM80 Past Briefing and SPM80 Past Review).

DECIDED 2026-10-20 (AC2): a booking clashes when its room-in-use period (start minus setup, end plus turnaround) overlaps another booking's, SPM-93's rule. Periods that only meet end to start do not clash (TC01, TC06, TC09). AC2's 'identifies the booking it clashes with' is shown in three places: after the save on the venue page ('(clashes with <reference> <title>)'), in the coordinator's notification, and on Flagged Arrangements (Availability).

DECIDED 2026-10-20 (AC5): a new reason code, booking_clash, worded 'with the venue's new setup or turnaround time, this booking overlaps another booking'. A booking that now runs into an unavailable period gets SPM-45's 'the venue is unavailable during this booking'. The notification is titled 'Booking needs review' (SPM-39's), names the change ('the turnaround time changed from 30 to 45 minutes'), the booking ('approved booking' or 'pending booking request'), and each booking or period it now overlaps. It goes to the event's assigned coordinator, or to the person who requested the booking when the event has none, as SPM-39 does. If one save both shrinks the venue and creates a clash, the coordinator gets one notification for each.

RESOLVED 2026-10-20: AC8 needed no new code. Since SPM-93, a new request is checked against the venue's setup and turnaround as they are when it is made (TC08, TC09). SPM-93-TC12 covers the same check against an unavailable period.
RESOLVED 2026-10-20: only Venue Staff can change a venue's setup or turnaround time; that refusal was built and is covered in SPM-39 (SPM-39-TC14), so no case repeats it here.

Fixtures: scripts/seed-spm80.ts (npm run fixtures:spm80) and its copy at the end of prisma/seed.ts. No schema change. Four rooms, all open 07:00–23:00, seating 40, with no setup or turnaround: 'SPM80 Turnaround Room' (SPM80-TRN), 'SPM80 Setup Room' (SPM80-SET), 'SPM80 Maintenance Room' (SPM80-MNT; Maintenance on 5 Aug 2027, 14:00–16:00) and 'SPM80 Request Room' (SPM80-REQ). Ten events (seed keys spm80_…), coordinator Daniel Tan, each booking's times the same as its event's: SPM80 Morning Seminar, SPM80 Lunch Forum and SPM80 Evening Workshop (3 Aug 2027), SPM80 Past Briefing and SPM80 Past Review (1 Sep 2026, completed), SPM80 Product Demo and SPM80 Partner Meetup (4 Aug 2027; the Meetup's booking is Pending), SPM80 Afternoon Talk (5 Aug 2027), SPM80 Booked Seminar and SPM80 Follow-on Workshop (6 Aug 2027; the Workshop has no booking). Every run puts each room back to no setup or turnaround and resets the events' bookings and notifications in place. The script must be run once against the shared database before the cases can be run.
